name: On Air Light
author: ChuckBuilds
description: Retro broadcast ON AIR tally light. Activate remotely via MQTT or Home Assistant to signal you're on a call, recording, or live — stays on until you turn it off.

versions.notes: ON and OFF reach the panel within a frame on LEDMatrix cores that have BasePlugin.request_on_demand() / end_on_demand(): the plugin asks the display directly from its MQTT thread instead of writing the display_on_demand_request cache file, which the display reads only once a second while its control socket is up and which a future core removes. On those cores OFF ends only the sign's own on-demand session, so it no longer stops something else the user put on screen meanwhile. On older cores, or when no display answers, it writes the file as before.

Home Assistant no longer shows the sign as on after LEDMatrix restarts: the state and label topics are retained, and the plugin now republishes its current state each time it connects instead of only on the next toggle. The device's sw_version comes from manifest.json (it was stuck at 1.2.0). Docs: TLS is not supported (the port hint said to use 8883), font_size 0 means 8 px with a custom font, and the retained-message clearing command no longer passes both -m and -n.

Store description only: the dash before "stays on" showed as three garbled characters (a UTF-8 em dash that had been decoded as Windows-1252 and saved back) and is now an em dash. No change in behaviour.

Home Assistant now sees the sign go offline on a clean shutdown or settings save. The offline availability was published after the client had disconnected, so it never left, and a clean disconnect does not trigger the last will; it is now published, and delivery awaited, before disconnecting.
Settings text only: with a Font path set, font_size 0 means 8 px; auto-sizing applies to the built-in font.

The MQTT connection recovers from a silent or refusing broker. A broker that never answered left the loop waiting forever, so the sign stopped responding to Home Assistant until a restart; a refused login redialled every 5 s with no backoff, leaving the previous client running each time. The loop now tears a failed client down before redialling and backs off 1, 2, 4 ... 60 s, as pomodoro-timer does. Shutdown releases the client even if the loop thread has died.

Load the pixel fallback font on its grid. When no system TTF and no configured font are available, a panel 32px or shorter fell back to the core's extra_small_font -- 4x6-font at ppem 6, one pixel off that face's 7px design grid. This plugin draws 1-bit, and the mono rasteriser thresholds an off-grid glyph down from 4px wide to 3px, so W/M and 0/8 stop being distinguishable. It now loads the same file at 7px, with the core attribute kept as the fallback.
Validation-sweep fixes; see the PR for the specific defect.

versions.changelog: Render text 1-bit (no anti-aliasing) so glyphs stay crisp on the LED grid

versions.notes: Font resolution and documentation. The sign looked for the LEDMatrix assets folder two levels above the plugin, which is only correct when the plugins directory sits inside the core tree; anywhere else it found nothing and silently fell back to a built-in font a fraction of the intended size. It now asks the imported core where it lives, keeping the old guess and the working directory as fallbacks. The README gains real rendered screenshots and the config.json key for every setting, corrects two claims about the label that the code does not implement, and fixes five automation examples that set 'color' where they meant 'bg'.
Also mark mqtt_password as x-secret (in addition to x-sensitive) so the web UI masks it consistently with other plugins.

Config schema reorganized for a clearer setup experience: fine-tuning fields moved behind the web UI's collapsed Advanced Settings section (x-advanced). UX-only; no fields, defaults, or behavior changed.

Update the README to match the current config schema and behavior: replace the removed pulsing/glow/tally-dot options with the actual text color, background color, font, and Home Assistant discovery fields; fix the per-message color/bg payload docs; and drop the broken preview image reference.
Add a GPL-3.0 LICENSE file (project-standard license). Remove the invalid update_interval:0 manifest field (this plugin is MQTT push-driven and does not poll, matching mqtt-notifications).

Fully customisable display: text, font path, font size, text color, background color. Removed animation/glow/tally-dot. Font loaded via PIL ImageFont.truetype with auto fallback to built-in display fonts. Per-MQTT-message color and bg override via JSON payload.

Add HA MQTT Auto-Discovery: plugin publishes device + switch/sensor/binary_sensor configs on connect so HA creates the device automatically. Adds LWT for accurate offline detection. New config fields: ha_discovery, discovery_prefix, device_name.
Initial release. MQTT-driven ON AIR tally light with pulsing red glow, state feedback topic, and Home Assistant switch compatibility.
